title: Astrometry.net Solve Status Mix
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=astrometry:solve
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(solve_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Astrometry.net solve feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `solve_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts the overall mood of your Astrometry.net solve feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
